_help: Matching rules, read by the app and by pipeline/rules.py. A selector matches a piece when every listed field has one of the listed values. Fields come from pieces.json: colour, kind (trouser|chino|denim), style (loafer|boot|sneaker), tex (pattern|chunky), w (warmth weight), casual.

shoes._help: First entry whose 'shoes' selector matches decides. The trousers must match one of its 'with' selectors, else the look is a Rethink. Shoes matching no entry get a warning.

pairs.say: Black loafers want grey, charcoal or grey denim
Brown leather wants brown, beige, blue or grey
Sneakers only with denim and chinos

clash._help: Colour families that should not meet in one outfit. Each hit is a warning.
clash.say: Black and brown compete here. Keep one family.

texture._help: Only one texture hero: an outer with one of 'outer' and a top with one of 'top' together is a warning.
texture.say: Patterned coat and chunky knit both shout. Pick one.

warmth._help: In the listed months (1=Jan) outer weight + top weight must reach 'min', and a top of weight <= 'light' needs an outer layer.
warmth.say_low: Too light for Copenhagen Oct–Mar. Add a coat or a heavier knit.
warmth.say_light: A light knit needs a coat this time of year.

occasion._help: Pieces whose 'occasions' list (pieces.json) lacks the chosen occasion are flagged.

dress_down._help: A casual outer over tailoring, leather shoes and a non-casual top. Warning.
dress_down.say: The puffer dresses tailoring down. Fine for the commute, swap coats at the office.

verdict._help: Any failed shoe rule = Rethink. Otherwise 0 warnings = Strong match, 1 = Works with one tweak, 2+ = Rethink.
